Collect [[Scarab Spore]]s for Scholar Chago.

==Quest information==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = nightfall
}}

===Objectives===
* Travel to [[Fahranur]].
* Kill insects and gather 10 [[Scarab Spore]]s for Scholar Chago. 0...10 of 10 spores gathered.
* See Scholar Chago for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 125 [[Gold]]
* 15 [[Sunspear Promotion Points]]
* [[Battle Commendation]]

== Walkthrough ==

You can farm insects in [[Fahranur, The First City]]. Start from [[Blacktide Den]] if you want a party of eight.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Scholar Chago
:''"I have a theory about the plague, but I cannot be certain until I have performed some experiments. If you are still willing to help me, I would appreciate if you could travel back to Fahranur and gather spores from the insects that live there. I think they may have had more to do with the plague than I previously suspected. If you can get me at least 10 spores, I should have enough to perform my experiments."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Bug squashing time!
| decline = Are you kidding me? I'm not going back there!
| ask = Please, go to Fahranur and gather 10 scarab spores from the insects that have infested the place. I need them for my experiments.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Scholar Chago
:''"Chuusi! Excellent! These seem to be in good condition."''

==Notes==
* It's a good idea to do the quest [[Defender's Choice]] at the same time, since the insects reached from the Jokanur Diggings entrance is near the targets for Defender's Choice.
